title: 第十一章 惊天虎啸第十二章 刁蛮少女
content_zh:
紧了紧手中药锄，叶枫背靠大树缓缓后退，他的眼神却在环视四周，观察着狼群的一举一动。
嗷！
一声怒吼，为首狼王没有动，反而另有一只高大野狼扑向叶枫，剩下的则形成合围之势，在狼王带领下，速度快如闪电。
狼群自有一套捕猎技巧。
沙沙沙……
急促声音让叶枫浑身绷紧，汗毛乍起。
所幸这处地方树木密集，狭隘的空间并不利于狼群围攻。
五丈，三丈，一丈……
刷……
药锄劈出，连一点破空声都没有，迎面扑上的高大野狼只看见一道黑影闪过，它抬起头颅，欲要咬住攻击自己的武器，却没想到叶枫手中药锄比灵蛇还要灵活，刚刚还是从上而下劈落，忽然方向一转，变成了横扫。
噗……
药锄砸中了狼腰，六七百斤巨力使得整条野狼凌空飞了出去，加之腰部本就是野狼最为脆弱的部位，只来得及发出一阵凄厉声，高大的野狼尸体撞断数条树枝，翻到在灌木丛中再也无法起来了。
一击得手，叶枫的人影没入大树背后。
似乎闻到了同类死亡的味道，狼王发出怒吼声，剩下几头野狼纷纷朝叶枫藏身的大树这边冲来。
在看到树前那一具同类尸体后，狼群齐齐停步，绿色的眸子在漆黑夜晚变得更加阴森恐怖。
嗷……
狼王再度咆哮，一马当先，带领着其他野狼齐齐扑向大树背后，可是当绕过大树后，却发现眼前空无一物，不见了猎物的踪影。
叶枫的确不在树背后，却在树上，当几头野狼奔到树后看到猎物消失而呆滞的瞬间，一道黑影凌空跃下，手中药锄包裹着一层层内劲，激荡得周边枯叶蜂拥飞舞。
一瞬间飞沙走石。
喝……

嗷……
短促呼喝和低沉狼嚎声同时响起。
狼王的反应不可谓不快，它周身坚毛根根竖起，獠牙毕露，朝着上方掠下的黑影迎面扑上，欲要咬断面前人类的咽喉，不过叶枫怎会给它这个机会，药锄在刹那之际脱手飞出。
“给我死！”
迎面刮起一阵狂风，灌注着浑厚内劲的药锄狠狠砸中狼王鼻孔部位，使得狼王由于剧痛而蜷缩起来的身躯坠回地面，与此同时，叶枫的人影也是坠地，只不过他依旧精准掌控着自己的行动，躲开两头野狼一前一后袭杀后，手掌一探，五根手指犹如钢爪，准确掐住倒地翻滚的狼王咽喉，随后双脚猛烈一蹬，身体如箭，重新跃上了大树。
剩下六头野狼怒吼不断，利爪扯碎树身。
可惜，老天没给野狼上树的本事。
居高临下俯视着狼群的举动，叶枫整个人如铁铸般挺立，他拎着狼王的右手朝前缓缓伸出，任由狼王在手底下挣扎、咆哮。
content_en:
Tightening the hand medicine hoe, Ye Feng slowly backed away against the big tree, but his eyes were looking around, observing every move of the wolves.
Ouch!
With a roar, the leader of the wolf king did not move. Instead, another tall wild wolf pounced on Ye Feng, and the rest formed an encirclement. Under the leadership of the wolf king, the speed was as fast as lightning.
Wolves have their own hunting techniques.
swish swish...
The urgent sound made Ye Feng's whole body tense up and the hair on his back stood up.
Fortunately, this place is densely populated with trees and the narrow space is not conducive to wolf siege.
Five feet, three feet, one foot...
Brush...
The medicine hoe struck out without even a sound of breaking through the air. The tall wild wolf that rushed towards him only saw a black shadow flashing past. It raised its head and tried to bite the weapon that attacked it. However, it did not expect that the medicine hoe in Ye Feng's hand was more flexible than the spirit snake. Just now, it was slashing from top to bottom, but suddenly the direction changed and it became a sweeping attack.
Poof...
The medicine hoe hit the wolf's waist, and the huge force of 600 to 700 kilograms caused the entire wild wolf to fly into the air. In addition, the waist was the most vulnerable part of the wild wolf. There was only time to make a scream, and the tall wild wolf corpse broke several branches, and it fell in the bushes and could no longer get up.
With one successful blow, Ye Feng's figure disappeared behind the big tree.
As if smelling the death of its kind, the Wolf King roared, and the remaining wild wolves rushed towards the big tree where Ye Feng was hiding.
After seeing the corpse of the same kind in front of the tree, the wolves all stopped, their green eyes becoming even more eerie in the dark night.
Ouch...
The wolf king roared again, taking the lead, leading the other wild wolves to rush behind the big tree. However, after bypassing the big tree, they found that there was nothing in front of them, and there was no trace of the prey.
Ye Feng was indeed not behind the tree, but on the tree. When several wild wolves ran behind the tree and saw their prey disappear, they were stunned. A black shadow jumped down from the sky, and the medicinal hoe in its hand was wrapped with layers of inner energy, causing the surrounding dead leaves to swarm and fly.
In an instant, everything was like flying sand and stones.
drink...
Ouch...
A short shout and a low wolf howl sounded at the same time.
The Wolf King's reaction was not unpleasant. The fur on its body stood up and its fangs were exposed. It rushed towards the black shadow sweeping above, intending to bite the throat of the human in front of it, but how could Ye Feng give it this chance? The medicine hoe flew out in an instant.
"Die!"
A gust of wind blew in the face, and the medicinal hoe filled with strong internal energy hit the Wolf King's nostril hard, causing the Wolf King's curled-up body to fall back to the ground due to severe pain. At the same time, Ye Feng's figure also fell to the ground, but he was still energetic. He accurately controlled his actions, dodged the attacks of two wild wolves one after another, reached out with his palms, and his five fingers were like steel claws, accurately pinching the throat of the wolf king who was rolling on the ground. Then he kicked hard with his feet, his body was like an arrow, and he jumped up the tree again.
The remaining six wild wolves roared incessantly, tearing the tree apart with their sharp claws.
It's a pity that God didn't give wild wolves the ability to climb trees.
Looking down at the actions of the wolves, Ye Feng stood upright as if made of iron. He took the Wolf King's right hand and slowly stretched it forward, letting the Wolf King struggle and roar under his hand.
